notes.title: Alone In a Dream Demo 0.38v Patch notes
notes.content:
[b]Patch notes:[/b]
-Improved wall jump control
-Fixed the issue where the player experienced stuttering when simultaneously pressing the Run key and the Sneak key
-Improve menu control:
  [i]ex)When you press the down arrow on the last menu tab, it moves to the first tab[/i]
-Change all dialogue to be printed without waiting if you press the next key during the dialogue output
-Fixed the issue that death instantly when it collides with a thorn in the boss battle

notes.title: [Alone In a Dream] Rework Demo Version Update
notes.content:
Reworked with a new look, the first version of [b]Alone In a Dream Demo[/b] has been updated!
You've been waiting for a long time. I'll continue to develop it in the future,
and I'll soon add more content and release it as Early-Access!

If you are installed the previous version,
please delete the previous version and reinstall it!
(After installation, check the version in-game: 0.36a)
Thank you.

notes.title: 0.16v Update
notes.content:
[b]Patch Note:[/b]
-Added chapter selection to stage selection window
-Improving some of the stage 1 maps
-Correct projectile angle when using magic on moving tiles

[b]Bug Fix:[/b]
-공격 판정을 가진 먹구름이 기능을 멈추고 잔류하던 버그 수정
-먹구름이 1스테이지의 챕터 2에서도 공격하던 버그 수정

notes.title: 0.15v Update
notes.content:
[b]Patch Notes:[/b]
-Added game exit button to stage selection screen
-Added functionality that ends when Esc is pressed twice in a row on the main screen
-Now all Cutscenes can now be skipped
-Added Stage 1 BGM
-Stage 1 map some modified

[b]Bug Fixed:[/b]
-Menu UI bug fixed
-Fixed a bug whose map name was not output correctly at the start of the stage
